name: Table
description: Table is a styled wrapper around the native <table> element. It supports automatic or fixed layouts, optional zebra striping, and sticky headers, while passing through theming from Box. Use it together with TableHead, TableBody, TableRow, and TableCell to build accessible, consistent data tables.

props.name: layout
props.description: Sets the CSS table-layout algorithm: 'auto' (content-driven) or 'fixed' (width-driven).

props.name: zebra
props.description: Enables alternating background colors for rows to improve readability.

props.name: stickyHeader
props.description: Keeps the header row visible at the top while scrolling the table body.
